notes: The canary: the smallest possible patch on a stock car other than the Mammoth, and the first vehicle mod a newcomer sees.
It adds one golf bag with clubs, strapped to The Ding's roof, as our own geometry (tools/golf_bag.py) inserted into each body LOD.
Nothing else changes: same wheelbase, track, suspension and steering, no new item, nothing in the save. Remove it with make undeploy, or delete this folder and redeploy.

listing.variant: stock, with a golf bag on the roof

real.basis: A patch on the game's stock Ding (a starter vehicle): one golf bag strapped to the roof, the canary for modding a stock vehicle.

notes: The stock Ding's own LOD3 body shows an 85.5 cm2 back-face patch at its front bumper (z 1.89..1.99, low centre), identical in the extracted stock mesh: the game's, not ours.
Accepted at 90 cm2 so any new culled patch or gap from the bag still fails; the bag's own LODs add none.
x, z: the bag's centre on the roof, Unity car-root space (x right, z forward). roofY, legY: from python3 tools/golf_bag.py vehicles/dingding/vehicle.json --measure.

Colours are flat points on the Ding's own atlas that every Ding livery leaves alone (outside the livery-blue mask): orange (the small side-marker square), dark grey and mid grey. The atlas has no teal or yellow outside the livery areas, so the bag is orange with dark-grey trim and grey irons.
